```{r}
required <- c("readr", "DT", "knitr")
missing <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) stop("Missing report package(s): ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
root <- normalizePath(file.path("..", "..", "02_analysis", "output", "stage2"), mustWork = TRUE)
read_table <- function(name) readr::read_csv(file.path(root, "tables", name), show_col_types = FALSE)
show_table <- function(x, caption) DT::datatable(x, caption = caption, rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top", options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
show_figure <- function(name) knitr::include_graphics(file.path(root, "figures", name))
```

# Scope

This stage evaluates associations of exposures, maternal characteristics, and
growth measures with infant hormone concentrations, followed by associations
between log-transformed hormones and growth. The analysis is performed by
`02_analysis/03_stage2.R`.

# Hormone distributions

::: panel-tabset
## Original

```{r}
show_figure("hormone_distributions_original.png")
```

## Log-transformed

```{r}
show_figure("hormone_distributions_log.png")
```
:::

# Categorical predictors and hormones

```{r}
show_table(read_table("wilcoxon_hormones.csv"), "Mann–Whitney U tests for log-transformed hormones")
show_figure("wilcoxon_hormones_selected.png")
```
